name: Sumikko Tantei Kurabu PARTII Ushirometai Shoujo
original_name: スミッコ探偵倶楽部PARTII うしろめたい少女
source:
Once again, a terrifying bonus feature that somehow came into existence has appeared as a preorder bonus. The old-school command-based ADV format only heightens the fear—and the production staff are terrified of the schedule needed to make it.

Speaking of summer, scary stories are a classic, after all... right!?

If the main story represents the light, then this is truly the darkness.

So, what kind of memories will you make during this one summer (Natsukuru)? Will they be filled with laughter? Or with terror?

For some reason, the only person who knows the truth is scenario writer Takumi Arakawa, who actually agreed to it by saying, “Let’s do it!”
translation:
不知为何诞生的恐怖特典，这一次又作为预约特典再度降临了！老派的指令选择式冒险游戏形式令恐怖感倍增——而制作组更是对赶制这部特典所需的工期感到毛骨悚然。

毕竟说到夏天，怪谈鬼故事可是经典标配……对吧！？

如果说本篇代表的是光明，那么这部特典就是彻头彻尾的黑暗。

那么，在这一个夏天（《なつくる》）里，你将镌刻下怎样的回忆？是充满欢声笑语，还是充斥着无尽恐惧？

不知为何，唯一知晓真相的就只有当初一口答应“那就干吧！”的剧本作家荒川工而已。
